scope: Corollary 2.9 (Freezing the real center) of the manuscript “Semialgebraic universal covers of normal projective varieties” (preprints/Semialgebraic-universal-covers-of-normal-projective-varieties-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 058 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dd294523779a9237), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let a definable family be written using Re b and Im b, and let Rt → 0 be a fixed real power matrix, independent of the real center x. For the substitution b = x + Rt(u + iv) its upper-limit and open-kernel tests at generic x are independent of u. Thus the kernels are invariant under real translations in the scaled coordinates. The tests may include remaining bounded fibre variables jointly. More generally, when a normalization Rt(x) depends definably on x, Lemma 2.8 applies to the normalized closed-set tests themselves.
